finish.summary: Built a 6-cell hexagonal small-parts organizer with six separate bins: one full bin, two full-depth 2-compartment bins, one full-depth 3-compartment bin, one half-depth 2-compartment bin, and one half-depth 3-compartment bin. House rules applied (capOpenFaces end caps, lockJoints joint bolts). Bins are staged with screw, nut and standoff heap props in their compartments, visible from above. check_build passes with meshClash clear and no issues.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
